FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG Figure 5 is an acyclic three-edge C-DMG, not the proposed cyclic Hstar, and does not give this same-law separation.

YvernesEtAl2026DerivationGraphs Theorem 6 treats equivalence of two interventional expressions in one ADMG; TehSadeghiSoo2025RobustID gives a sufficient candidate-MPDAG criterion, not equality on hidden-variable image intersections.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Proposition 2 (conditional Global-CID)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Paired response-table compression and ranked overlap saturation are assumed as certified subroutines rather than proved by this proposition.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Global-CID and the B_out complexity guarantee are claimed only conditional on those two supplied subroutines.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Figure 5 has the acyclic C-DAG Cw→Cx, Cw→Cy, Cx→Cy; its two compatible ADMGs identify Pr(y1|do(x1)) as Pr(y1|x1).
The paper states that positivity of P(V) is sometimes assumed but is not assumed in that paper.
The paper introduces C-DAGs and states soundness and completeness of standard ID for causal effects from observational data given an acyclic C-DAG.
The result supplies a sufficient simultaneous-identification criterion over a candidate set of SA-MPDAGs with background knowledge.
Theorem 6 gives a four-rule canonical sequence for equivalent expressions in one ADMG; Section 6 identifies finite representations for ID-algorithm reductions as open.
The paper uses finite canonical SCMs with the same fixed causal diagram to formulate counterfactual bounds as polynomial programs.
The paper derives influence-function-based estimation for identifiable effects in hidden-variable graphical models and a graph-to-weight identification algorithm.
The paper studies inference for directionally differentiable maps, including delta-method and nonstandard-bootstrap behavior near nondifferentiability.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every Figure-5 description with its actual acyclic three-edge C-DAG, then search and cite a genuinely cyclic known-size comparator for Hstar or explicitly state that Hstar is a new cyclic regime.

Repair semantic gluing by making ordinary-ID success explicit, or define arbitrary local identifying maps before using phi_G; separately correct the positivity citation or retag the restriction as an intentional model restriction.

Turn the overlap handle into an algorithmic flagship specification by stating explicit bounds on rank coordinates, state encoding, transition count, and output length rather than leaving E4 only as a conditional objective.

recommended_next_step: Revise the comparator characterization, add the missing Yvernes anchor, and repair the local-functional and positivity-assumption defects before advancing the overlap-normal-form angle.
